7.4.3 Transmission mode
[SWS_FrTSyn_00026]
⌈If FrTSyn_SetTransmissionMode(Controller, Mode)is called and parameter Mode equals FRTSYN_TX_OFF, all transmit requests from FrTSyn shall be omitted on this FlexRay channel.⌋(RS_TS_20039, RS_TS_- 20043, RS_TS_20044)
[SWS_FrTSyn_00027]
⌈If FrTSyn_SetTransmissionMode(Controller, Mode) is called and parameter Mode equals FRTSYN_TX_ON, all transmit requests from FrTSyn on this FlexRay channel shall be able to be transmitted.⌋(RS_TS_20039, RS_TS_20043, RS_TS_20044)
